title: Pomodoro Technique
description: Study for 25 minutes with full focus, then take a short break before starting another session.
tip: Remove distractions before starting the timer and focus on only one task.

title: Distraction-Free Study
description: Create a quiet study environment by turning off notifications and removing unnecessary distractions.
tip: Put your phone on silent or leave it in another room while studying.

title: Single Task Focus
description: Work on one assignment or topic at a time instead of switching between several tasks.
tip: Write down your most important task and finish it before moving to another one.

title: Active Recall
description: Practice remembering information without looking at your notes or textbook.
tip: Close your notes and explain the topic in your own words.

title: Spaced Repetition
description: Review information several times over a period of days instead of studying everything at once.
tip: Review difficult information more often and familiar information less often.

title: Flashcard Review
description: Use flashcards to practice important terms, definitions, formulas, and concepts.
tip: Try answering each card before turning it over to check the answer.

title: Weekly Study Plan
description: Create a weekly schedule that includes assignments, study sessions, and important deadlines.
tip: Plan your most difficult subjects during times when you usually have the most energy.

title: Priority List
description: Organize school tasks by importance and deadline so you know what needs attention first.
tip: Choose your three most important tasks before beginning your study session.

title: Break Large Assignments
description: Divide large projects into smaller steps that can be completed over several study sessions.
tip: Give each smaller step its own deadline.

title: Practice Questions
description: Use practice questions to test your understanding and identify topics that need more review.
tip: Review incorrect answers and find out why your first answer was wrong.

title: Exam Review Schedule
description: Plan several short review sessions before an exam instead of studying everything the night before.
tip: Begin reviewing several days before the exam when possible.

title: Teach the Topic
description: Explain a topic as if you were teaching it to another student to check how well you understand it.
tip: If you cannot explain something simply, review that part again.

title: Focused Reading
description: Read a section carefully while looking for the main ideas, important details, and unfamiliar terms.
tip: Write a short summary after finishing each section.

title: Preview Before Reading
description: Preview headings, questions, images, and summaries before reading a chapter in detail.
tip: Use the headings to predict what information you expect to learn.

title: Reading Notes
description: Take short notes while reading to identify key concepts and organize important information.
tip: Write ideas in your own words instead of copying complete sentences.
